title: Ally Appears
next_chapter_hook: The words left by that dissipating figure struck like thunder—the confrontation between the Imperial Court forces and the Eye of Heavenly Secrets was far more ancient than Chen Ji had ever known. And when Chen Ji opened his eyes again, an unexpected inheritance awaited him.

text.content: In the abyss-like darkness, Chen Ji's consciousness drifted like a falling leaf, floating in the endless Void. The golden light of the fourth page of the Tianji Record became the sole beacon in this blackness, and the outline of the complete Tianji Record gradually emerged, as if an ancient giant beast was awakening. And in the deepest part of the golden light, that cold eye still watched him, carrying pressure and scrutiny beyond mortal comprehension—the Eye of Heavenly Secrets. Chen Ji finally realized that from the very beginning, he had been nothing more than a chess piece manipulated in this grand game.

Meanwhile, on the battlefield beyond the abyss, Ye Qing's slender figure shielded Chen Ji. The Demonic Path mist churned around her, yet couldn't conceal the increasingly dense scent of blood. The footsteps of the Holy Sect pursuers drew closer—seven auras in total, each at least at the Foundation Building later stage. A trace of blood dripped from the corner of Ye Qing's mouth; forcing the Demonic Path mist to protect Chen Ji had already worsened her injuries.

dialogue.content: "Demonic Path witch, do you think you alone can stop the Seven Heroes of the Holy Sect?" The leading pursuer coldly laughed, his blade shimmering with an eerie purple light. "Hand over that kid and the Tianji Record Fragment, and the Holy Sect may still leave your corpse intact!"

text.content: Ye Qing gave no answer. She slowly raised her black silk folding fan, on which a blood-red Manjusaka flower bloomed妖异地 under the moonlight. Her gaze was cold as frost, yet her lips curved into a mocking arc—she had heard such threats far too many times during her years in the Holy Sect, and every person who spoke those words ultimately died beneath her fan. But at this moment, did she truly need to fight desperately for the waste behind her?

Just then, a sudden change occurred. A cyan sword light slashed down from the Void, carrying righteous energy, directly wounding the two leading pursuers. The sword light was so fierce it seemed capable of tearing apart the heavens; even the air was sliced with sharp whistling sounds. All seven pursuers stopped simultaneously, their faces filled with terror as they gazed toward the source of the sword light—where a middle-aged man in blue robes was slowly walking forward, each step seeming to trample upon their hearts.

dialogue.content: Ye Qing's pupils slightly constricted. This aura... far exceeded her imagination. She unconsciously gripped her fan tighter, but in the next instant sensed that the sword intent carried no malice; instead, it bore a steadiness so familiar it sent chills through her. A thought suddenly flashed through her mind—that sword intent, and the sealed power within Chen Ji, were surprisingly similar!

"Who are you, to dare obstruct the Holy Sect's business!" The leading pursuer's courage belied his words, his blade trembling in his hand. The middle-aged man's aura was too terrifying—as if with a single thought, he could slaughter all seven of them. The middle-aged man didn't even glance at him, simply speaking indifferently, his voice low yet carrying undeniable authority: "The Holy Sect's reach has extended too far."

text.content: Before his words even finished, another sword light slashed down. This strike was even more fierce than the last, carrying an aura of utter destruction. All seven pursuers simultaneously spat blood, their bodies hurled dozens of zhang away by the sword intent and crashing heavily to the ground, unable to move. Having done all this, the middle-aged man finally turned, his gaze falling upon the unconscious Chen Ji. His eyes flickered with complex emotions—relief, heartache, and a trace of barely perceptible guilt.

dialogue.content: Ye Qing forced herself forward despite her injuries, killing intent surging within her扇骨. Her voice was deep: "Who exactly are you? This sword intent... is not something an ordinary cultivator could possess. More importantly, why save him?" Her instincts told her that this mysterious person's appearance was no coincidence, especially that familiar aura, which made her不得不提高vigilant.

text.content: The middle-aged man finally looked directly at Ye Qing, a meaningful smile curving his lips: "Little丫头, your Demonic Path mist cultivation is quite good. Being able to conceal the Tianji Record's aura—this talent is rare." His words shocked Ye Qing to her core—he actually knew the true purpose of the Demonic Path mist? This was absolutely a secret beyond ordinary people!

dialogue.content: "You... What is your relationship with Chen Ji?" Ye Qing's voice slightly trembled. An unbelievable thought arose in her heart. That ordinarily cowardly and useless waste, that man she had deemed merely a small piece in the chess game—did he actually have some unknown background? The aura on this mysterious person was identical to the sealed power within Chen Ji—could it be that...?

text.content: The middle-aged man gave no direct answer. Instead, he walked to Chen Ji's side and pressed one hand to his forehead. Awarm的灵 力 surged into Chen Ji's body, creating resonance with the Tianji Record's golden light. The unconscious Chen Ji furrowed his brows slightly, as if sensing something in his dream. At the same time, an ancient voice rang out from the Void—it was Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul!

dialogue.content: Mo Xiansheng's voice carried a tremor, as if witnessing something unbelievable: "This aura... You're... Impossible! Weren't you supposed to have..." The middle-aged man淡淡一笑: "Greetings, Master.没想到您还记得我 after twenty years apart." Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul剧烈fluctuationed in the Void, seemingly too excited to speak.

text.content: Listening to these two's conversation, Ye Qing's mind buzzed. Twenty years ago? That was before Chen Ji was even born! Who was this mysterious person? What kind of connection existed between him, Chen Ji, the Tianji Record, and Mo Xiansheng? Countless questions surged in her heart, but more than anything, she felt anger at being deceived—Chen Ji that waste, he had clearly been hiding something from the very start!

choice.prompt: The mysterious benefactor revealed his identity to Ye Qing and asked whether she was willing to temporarily become Chen Ji's guardian. Ye Qing needed to make a choice.

choices.description: Ye Qing chose to trust this mysterious person, officially becoming Chen Ji's guardian while also obtaining intelligence about the Imperial Court forces.

The middle-aged man stood with hands behind his back, his gaze distant: "I am his father—Chen Xuan. Twenty years ago, when I passed the Tianji Record to him, I knew this day would come."

text.content: Chen Xuan! Ye Qing's pupils abruptly constricted. That waste Chen Ji, beneath that so-calledtrash人设, actually had such an earth-shattering father? And the Tianji Record's inheritance, the father's layout, the son's hidden cultivation... all of this was a hundred times more complex than she had imagined!

dialogue.content: Ye Qing did not immediately agree, instead coldly saying: "Words alone carry no weight. If you truly are Chen Ji's father, do you have proof?" The middle-aged man—Chen Xuan—heard this and laughed instead of getting angry: "The little丫头 is quite cautious." He waved his hand, and a cyan light entered Ye Qing's眉心—it was a scene: when young Chen Ji was learning to write, a man was teaching him hand over hand, and that man's face was identical to Chen Xuan's.

text.content: After viewing that memory, Ye Qing's heart was deeply shaken. Although she remained vigilant, the warmth in that memory could not be faked. More importantly, she saw a key piece of information in this memory—Chen Xuan's layout was far deeper than she had imagined. Twenty years ago he had already begun arranging for today's situation, and this so-called waste Chen Ji had from the start been a key piece in the chess game!

Just then, Chen Xuan's expression suddenly tensed. He looked up at the Void, his brow furrowed: "Time is running out; the Eye of Heavenly Secrets' gaze grows stronger." He turned to look at the unconscious Chen Ji, a trace of reluctance flashing in his eyes, then channeled a cyan light into Chen Ji's body: "This is the last gift I leave him. When he wakes up, tell him—the war between the Imperial Court forces and the Eye of Heavenly Secrets is about to begin, and he is the key to determining victory or defeat."

dialogue.content: Ye Qing hastily pursued: "What are the Imperial Court forces? What grudge do they have with the Eye of Heavenly Secrets?" Chen Xuan's figure had already begun to fade, as if it might dissipate from this Void at any moment. He cast one final glance at Chen Ji, his voice low and grave: "In ancient times, there was a group of people unwilling to be chess pieces of Heaven. They established the Imperial Court and fought against the Eye of Heavenly Secrets for ten thousand years. Now, the war will flare up once more, and you... must guard him well for me."

text.content: As his words fell, Chen Xuan's figure completely dissipated, leaving only a cyan light entering Chen Ji's body and an ancient jade pendant falling into Ye Qing's hand. On the pendant was carved an ancient character "Chen", and on the back was a fragmented map seemingly pointing to some mysterious location. Ye Qing tightly clutched the jade pendant, her heart churning with immense waves—Imperial Court forces, the Eye of Heavenly Secrets, a ten-thousand-year war... these pieces of information completely overturned her understanding of this world.

Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul sighed, his voice carrying endless emotion: "Chen Xuan... he ultimately chose this path." Ye Qing pressed: "Master, do you know him? What kind of person is he?" Mo Xiansheng沉默片刻才道: "He was a candidate for the previous generation's Tianji Record inheritance, and also... Chen Ji's father. Twenty years ago, to protect the young Chen Ji, he voluntarily relinquished the inheritance, sealing the Tianji Record into his son's body. He himself joined the Imperial Court and fought against Heaven to this day."

Ye Qing finally understood. That so-calledtrash Chen Ji had from the moment of his birth been protected by his father with the Tianji Record, while his father had used his own body to stand between the Eye of Heavenly Secrets and his son, using twenty years of patience and layout to buy time for his son to grow. This fatherly love was so heavy it was suffocating. She lowered her gaze to the still-unconscious Chen Ji, and for the first time felt that this "waste's" back looked so lonely and heavy.
